messages.subject: Can we reserve a specific unit?
messages.body:
Hi,

We'll need equipment again soon and I was hoping we could get the same unit we had last time. It was a good fit for our work. Is there a way to put a hold on it for our next visit?

Best regards,
Oulun Putkiasennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Can we reserve a specific unit?
messages.body:
Good morning,

I checked and that particular unit is unfortunately committed to another booking right now. What I can do is set aside a replacement unit of the same type for you and hold it at the same rate. It'll be ready whenever you need it.

Just send us the dates when you have them.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Can we reserve a specific unit?
messages.body:
We're ready to book now. Outi confirmed in her reply that a replacement unit would be held for us at the same rate. We've planned our schedule around that commitment so please make sure it stands.

Oulun Putkiasennus Oy

messages.subject: Account data access
messages.body:
Hello,

I'd like to know who has accessed my account data and for what purpose. I've been a customer for a few years now and I think I'm entitled to know how my information is being used.

Could you send me the details?

Mikko Rantanen

messages.subject: Re: Account data access
messages.body:
Hi Mikko,

I've received your request and passed it on to the team that handles these matters. We'll come back to you once we have the information together.

Hanna-Kaisa Louhi
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Account data access
messages.body:
Also, separate question - I'm thinking about renting a plate compactor. Do you deliver to Oulu or is it pickup only?

Mikko

messages.subject: Need to move my booking
messages.body:
Hi there,

I booked a 140L concrete mixer from the Rovaniemi depot but I need to change the dates. Something came up and the original window doesn't work for me anymore. Can I shift it?

Thanks,
Laura

messages.subject: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
We received the damage assessment of EUR 300 for the scissor lift (10m) under RB-20263103. We'd like to request that this charge be waived. We rent from you regularly and have always returned equipment in proper condition. This feels excessive for what was really minor wear.

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Re: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for letting us know. I've noted your request regarding the damage charge and will look into the details. I'll get back to you once I've reviewed it.

Elina Rahkonen
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
Could you also send us a copy of the invoice? We need it for our records.

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Re: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
Of course. Could you specify which invoice you're referring to? We have several on file for your account.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
One more thing - we have a job coming up that needs a hydraulic concrete breaker. Do you offer delivery or would we need to pick it up ourselves?

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Damage waiver question
messages.body:
I rented from you for the first time in July and I'm planning another booking. My understanding is that the daily rental rate already includes the damage-waiver insurance. I want to make sure that's the case before I go ahead so I'm not charged for it separately.

Anniina Similä
